notes: littelfuse.com (and the old ixysic.com URLs) return 403 to curl/WebFetch (Akamai). Datasheets were downloaded from Wayback Machine captures of the official littelfuse.com assetdocs URLs (the 'url' field is the original Littelfuse URL); lifecycle read from Wayback captures of the product pages (2025-2026). CPC1004N had no usable Wayback capture and came from a Farnell mirror (R10, newer than the R09 on IHS).
Every datasheet lists only the tube part (no suffix) and the TR tape-and-reel suffix; no other package variants exist, so one row per part.
All 15 parts share the identical 4-pin SOP drawing and land pattern; footprint_check 'close' for all (see per-part note).
Older IXYS-format sheets (DS-...-Rxx) lose the Ohm/micro glyphs in pdftotext; values were read with the units confirmed against the newer Littelfuse-format sheets and page renders.
led_forward_voltage is the max from the electrical table (typ 1.36V, 1.2V for CPC1018N).
